items.title: 7.4.3 Types of reaction order (reaction order ki qismein) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 7.4.3, printed pages 155-156.

blocks.text: Zero Order Reaction
Zero order reaction ki rate reactants ki concentration par bilkul depend nahi karti. Concentration badalne se reaction ki speed (raftar) par koi asar nahi hota.
Aam reaction ke liye:

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Kisi bhi number ki power 0 ho to jawab 1 hota hai: [A]⁰ = 1. Is liye Rate = k × 1 = k; concentration kuch bhi ho, rate wahi rehti hai.
Examples (misalein):
Photochemical reactions (roshni se chalne wali reactions) aam taur par zero order hoti hain; in ki rate roshni par depend karti hai, concentration par nahi.
First Order Reaction
In reactions mein kai reactants ho sakte hain, lekin rate sirf ek reactant ki concentration par (power 1 ke saath) depend karti hai. First order reaction ki misal:
Nitrogen pentoxide (N₂O₅) ka decomposition (toot jana):
Is reaction ki experiment (tajurbe) se maloom ki gayi rate equation:
Yeh equation batati hai ke reaction N₂O₅ ki concentration ke hisaab se first order hai: N₂O₅ dugna karein to rate dugni.
Second Order Reaction

Jis reaction ki rate equation mein concentrations ki powers ka sum (jama) 2 ho, woh second order hai. Is ki rate ya to ek reactant ki concentration ki power 2 par depend karti hai, ya do alag reactants ki concentrations par, har ek ki power 1. Simple type mein sirf ek hi type ka reactant molecule hota hai.
Ozone (O₃) se nitric oxide (NO) ka oxidation NO ke hisaab se first order aur O₃ ke hisaab se first order paya gaya hai. Dono orders jama karein to overall (kul) order 2 hai.

blocks.text_alt: NO(g) + O₃(g) → NO₂(g) + O₂(g)   Rate = k[NO][O₃]

blocks.text: Third Order Reaction
Jis reaction ki rate equation mein concentrations ki powers ka sum 3 ho, woh third order reaction hai.
Is reaction mein aath (8) reactant molecules hain (2 FeCl₃ + 6 KI), lekin experiment se yeh third order nikli hai. Yani order coefficients ke sum se nahi milta.
Yeh reaction bhi third order hai:
Fractional Order Reaction (fraction wale order ki reaction)
Jis reaction ki rate equation mein powers ka sum fraction (poora number nahi, jaise 1.5) ho, use fractional order reaction kehte hain. Misal: chloroform (CHCl₃) se carbon tetrachloride (CCl₄) banna.
Free radicals (aise particles jin ke paas akela, unpaired electron ho) wali reactions aksar fractional order dikhati hain.

blocks.caption: Order ke types ek nazar mein

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Concentration dugni karne ka asar: zero order mein rate wahi (2⁰ = 1), first order mein dugni (2¹ = 2), second order mein chaar guna (2² = 4), third order mein aath guna (2³ = 8).

blocks.prompt: Ek reaction kisi reactant ke hisaab se second order hai. Us reactant ki concentration dugni karne par, aur aadhi karne par, rate kaise badlegi?
blocks.explanation: Dugni karne par rate 2² = 4 guna ho jayegi; aadhi karne par rate (½)² = ¼ reh jayegi, yani 4 guna kam.

blocks.text: Summary (khulasa)

items: Zero order: Rate = k (concentration ka asar nahi; photochemical reactions).
First: Rate = k[N₂O₅]. Second: k[A]² ya k[A][B] (NO + O₃). Third: k[NO]²[O₂], k[FeCl₃][KI]².
